build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: php artisan optimize && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=${PORT}
deploy.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'php artisan migrate --force && php artisan auth:publish-jwks'
